name: motif_overview
description:
Read the project Overview. Displays the latest saved counts, Text Coverage, manual-analysis agreement, timing, and warnings. It reads stored evidence and does not start a new run.
Command: overview. Agent class: Read.
ProposalId: The Proposal whose latest Trial supplies the evidence, or null for the project.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

name: motif_capture_baseline
description:
Capture a Baseline. Reads the saved .fwdata project to create or reuse a file-backed Baseline. Use it when the latest FieldWorks save should be the point of comparison for later work.
Command: baseline capture. Agent class: Evaluate.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_grammar
description: Read grammar. Reads the Baseline grammar by kind and exact object identity. Choose a kind to page through its objects, or omit it for counts.

name: motif_lexicon
description: Read lexicon. Searches Baseline entries and counts them by morph type and category. Filter by morphType, affix, category, headword or hasGloss. Concise results are one line per entry with its sense ids; detailed results include senses, allomorphs and their environments.

name: motif_word
description:
Read one word's context. Reads a word's captured FieldWorks presence and every stored analysis with its individual Opinion. Uses the current Baseline without requiring a Selection or an Assessment, and reports whether FieldWorks has saved since.
Command: word-context. Agent class: Read.
Word: The exact word form to read.
ExpectedBaseline: The required Baseline identity; null accepts the current Baseline.

name: motif_start_proposal
description:
Start a Proposal. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow; check best practice. Start one small Proposal per grammar question, then try it before anything else (guide workflow). Starts a named Draft holding one related set of semantic changes. Set a short label and a Rationale before Finalize, then measure and revise the Draft. Only a person can Apply.
Command: new. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
Label: The short description a person reads while reviewing the Proposal.

label.description: A one-line description a reviewer reads in Motif's window.

rationale.description: What this Proposal changes and why, in Markdown: the evidence, in a few sentences.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_guide
description: Read encoding guidance. Reads an encoding guide or the draft, Dry Run, Trial, revise and Finalize workflow.

name: motif_add_lexeme_form
description:
Author a lexeme form. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Keep variants of one morpheme under one entry with narrow conditions. Not for a regular sound change across forms: use a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages a lexeme form with explicitly authored spelling, writing system and morph type in a Draft. Dry Run and Trial the Draft before Finalize; only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-lexeme-form. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

ws.description: Writing system tag the form is written in.

environments.description: Optional environment ids restricting the new form.

is_abstract.description: True for a root-and-pattern form with no fixed segments.

sense.description: Id of an existing sense of the entry to gloss. Needs gloss_ws and gloss_text.

gloss_ws.description: Writing system tag of the gloss.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_feature_structure
description:
Author grammatical features. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Restrict a slot's affix by feature value; do not copy affixes or slots per value. Arbitrary lexical grouping is an inflection class (guide feature-conditioned-slots). Stages an empty feature structure on an existing or earlier-staged stem or inflectional affix MSA in a Draft, refusing an occupied slot even when its structure has no selections. Inflectional affix features are word requirements; use the returned exact structure identity to author selections. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-feature-structure. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: Closed {msa} input naming the exact canonical MSA identity. Its MsFeatures or InflFeats owning slot must be unoccupied; a present structure is refused even with no selections. Inflectional affix features are word requirements. Use the returned structure identity for selections.

msa.description: Id of a stem or inflectional affix MSA with no existing feature structure.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_phoneme
description:
Author a phoneme. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Add a phoneme for a real contrast, not only to record a surface variant, unless a rule needs it as an output segment (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs). Stages a phoneme with explicitly authored name and representations in a Draft. Use its created identity in later natural classes or phonological rules. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-phoneme. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

name.description: Phoneme name.

representations.description: Explicit grapheme codes, such as ['a'] or ['sh', 'š'].

feature.description: Closed feature id in the phonological feature system.

value.description: Symbolic value belonging to that feature.

features.description: Closed phonological feature/value pairs; copy ids from motif_grammar.

name: motif_add_natural_class
description:
Author a natural class. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Keep sound classes narrow: list only the sounds the pattern needs, never a class spanning unrelated sounds (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages a named segment natural class with explicitly declared phoneme members in a Draft. Members may name existing phonemes or phonemes created earlier through declared dependencies. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-natural-class. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

name: motif_add_environment
description:
Author an environment. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs or nasal-assimilation; check best practice. Keep the environment as narrow as the evidence. For a regular change across many forms use a phonological rule, not environments (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages an environment with explicitly declared left and right contexts in a Draft. Contexts use project phonemes, natural classes or boundaries. Only a person can Apply.

name: motif_add_phonological_rule
description:
Author a phonological rule. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use for a regular sound change across many forms. Not for one irregular word: use an alternate form or allomorph (guide conditioned-allomorphs). Stages one simple rewrite rule in a Draft, using existing phonemes and natural classes with explicit context and rule placement. Empty input or output means insertion or deletion; unsupported alpha variables and metathesis are refused. Only a person can Apply.

name: motif_add_affix_slot
description:
Author an affix slot. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Put affixes in slots in speakers' order. No entry per stem, and no one broad slot for affixes with different jobs (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Stages a named inflectional affix slot owned by an existing category and can assign existing inflectional affixes to it in the same Draft. name: motif_add_inflection_feature

Author inflection feature. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Restrict a slot's affix by feature value; do not copy affixes or slots per value. name: motif_add_inflection_class
description:
Author inflection class. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Use only when stems arbitrarily pattern differently for the same affix. A value that must agree is a feature, not a class (guide feature-conditioned-slots). Adds an inflection class or subclass, such as a noun class, to a Draft. Its owner is explicit and the category's default is unchanged; use the created id when authoring a stem.
Command: compose-author-inflection-class. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The Draft to append the authored operations to.
IntentJson: The closed inflection class input, resolved against the prepared Draft.

name: motif_add_stem_name
description:
Author a stem name. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Only names feature conditions; attach it with compose-edit-stem-allomorph-stem-name. For sound-conditioned forms use environments, not a stem name (guide conditioned-allomorphs). Adds a category-owned stem name with explicit feature regions to a Draft. Each region states where an allomorph bearing this stem name is eligible; attaching it to an allomorph is a separate operation.
Command: compose-author-stem-name. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The Draft to append the authored operations to.
IntentJson: The closed stem name input, resolved against the prepared Draft.

name: motif_add_lexical_entry
description:
Author a lexical entry. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. For an affix, prefer an inflectional or derivational MSA with categories and a slot over unclassified (guide suffix-prefix-slots). One entry per morpheme, not per stem. Stages one new dictionary entry with its lexeme form, one sense with gloss and optional definition, and grammatical info: a stem, or an inflectional, derivational or unclassified affix. Each form can name environments, and an affix can name the inflection classes it attaches to. Inspect its Dry Run and try words with it before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-author-lexical-entry. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

name: motif_add_alternate_form
description:
Author an alternate form. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use for a listed variant of one morpheme. Not for a regular sound change, a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation), or a pattern-based form (compose-author-affix-process-allomorph). Stages one more stem or affix form on an existing or earlier-staged entry, with its own environments and, for an affix, inflection classes. It adds no entry, sense or grammatical info and copies no condition from the lexeme form.

name: motif_add_part_of_speech
description:
Author a part of speech. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Add a category only when the evidence needs one; slots and classes belong to a category, so author it before them (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Stages a new part of speech, at the top of the category list or under an existing category, with its name and optional abbreviation. Later composer calls in the same Draft can use it as the category of entries, slots and affixes.

name: motif_add_affix_template
description:
Author an affix template. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Put affixes in slots in speakers' order. No entry per stem, and no one broad slot for affixes with different jobs (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Stages an active alternative template on an existing category, using ordered prefix and suffix slots that belong to the category or an ancestor. It preserves existing template order and records whether this template requires further derivation. Only a person can Apply.

name: motif_compose_batch
description:
Compose many intents. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow; check best practice. Prefer the specific typed composer; batch only stages several in one Draft. One small Proposal per grammar question (guide workflow). Stages every intent in a JSON file in one Draft with one project load, through the same checks as each composing command alone. If any intent is refused, nothing is added, and both a label and a Rationale are still required before Finalize. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-batch. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.

name: motif_add_affix_process
description:
Author an affix process. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use for infixes, reduplication and stem-internal changes. Another pattern-based form of an existing entry: compose-author-affix-process-allomorph. Regular nasal assimilation is a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages a new affix entry whose ordered input pattern matches phonemes, a natural class or the remaining stem, and whose output copies named parts or inserts phonemes: an infix, a partial or full reduplication, or a substitution that deletes matched input by omitting it from the output (Cebuano paN- before p/b gives m). It refuses an output that copies nothing or drops the remaining stem. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-author-affix-process. Agent class: Draft.

name: motif_add_affix_process_allomorph
description:
Add an affix process allomorph. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs or workflow; check best practice. Use for one morpheme with several pattern-based forms. Plain spelling variants use an alternate form; a new morpheme needs its own entry (guide conditioned-allomorphs). Stages one more pattern-based form, an affix process with its own input pattern and output, on an existing affix entry that already realizes itself as a process. The entry's morph type is copied and the form applies to all of the entry's grammatical info. It refuses a stem, an entry with plain allomorphs, a repeated pattern and a missing placement.
Command: compose-author-affix-process-allomorph. Agent class: Draft.

name: motif_add_feature_value
description:
Author a feature value. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Restrict a slot's affix by feature value; do not copy affixes or slots per value. Arbitrary lexical grouping is an inflection class (guide feature-conditioned-slots). Stages a closed feature specification in an existing or earlier-staged structure, with value omitted when unchosen. Inflectional affix requirements use current morphosyntactic definitions, and any supplied value must belong to the exact feature. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-feature-value. Agent class: Draft.

name: motif_edit_phoneme
description:
Edit a phoneme's representations. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Edit a phoneme for a real contrast, not only to record a surface variant, unless a rule needs it as an output segment (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs). Stages new written representations for an existing phoneme, or respells one it has, so a multigraph such as ng, ts or dy is another way the same segment is written and never a second phoneme. It refuses a spelling another phoneme or boundary already has, and a respelling that an environment writes. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-edit-phoneme. Agent class: Draft.

add.description: New representations to append, each an object with a representation, such as ng.

name: motif_edit_compound_rule
description:
Turn a compound rule off or on. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow or ask-the-linguist; check best practice. Only turns existing compounding off or on; it builds and fixes nothing. Trial known compounds before and after, and ask the linguist first (guide workflow). Stages one explicit Disabled value for an endocentric or exocentric compound rule in a Draft. FieldWorks compound rules join any two stems, so a rule that builds non-words can be switched off; the expected value guards against stale evidence, and only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-compound-rule. Agent class: Draft.

disabled.description: Whether the rule should be turned off: true to turn it off, false to turn it on.

name: motif_set_no_default_compounding
description:
Set default compounding. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow; check best practice. Only turns the parser's built-in default compounding off or on; it authors no compound rule. Trial known compounds first and ask the linguist (guide workflow). Stages one explicit change to the parser's built-in default compounding in a Draft. A project with no compound rules of its own still has the parser join any two stems unless default compounding is turned off; the expected value guards against stale evidence, and only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-set-no-default-compounding. Agent class: Draft.

expectedNoDefaultCompounding.description: Whether default compounding is turned off now: true when it is, false when it is on.

name: motif_rewrite_lexeme_form
description:
Rewrite lexeme forms. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Keep variants of one morpheme under one entry with narrow conditions. Not for a regular sound change across forms: use a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation). Rewrites the lexeme form of many existing entries in one Draft, each guarded by the form it must hold now, and can keep the old spelling as the citation form. Use it when the lexeme form carries stress marks the parser cannot match; Motif stages a Draft and never Applies it automatically. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-rewrite-lexeme-form. Agent class: Draft.
